title: Chapter 626
paragraphs: Chapter 626
Episode 161. Return (3)
The first emotion that filled Lanke Hallovich's mind was bewilderment.
'My jaw, it's broken!? In a single blow…!’
He prided himself on having the most sturdy body among the four ducal families of the demon world.
In all his life reigning as a strong man in the demon world, this was the first time a bone had broken from a single blow.
The next emotion that filled Lanke's heart was rage. Not only did he dare interrupt him, but he even threw a punch out of the blue!
However, it wasn't the time to lose his dignity yet. Just because the other person was rude didn't mean he, a noble, had to be the same.
Crack! Lanke, who had put some distance between them, forcibly aligned his dislocated jawbone.
The bone returned to its place and quickly recovered.
"Attacking a defenseless opponent has always been the exclusive trick of the lowly. Huh, in my joy, I greeted you first only to receive such rudeness... Ugh!”
Smash!
Lanke's jawbone broke again at the elbow swung by Jin. Lanke, feeling tears welling up, put some distance again.
"Ah, come on!"
Lanke realigned his jawbone that had once again dislocated.
"Were you off guard again?"
"No, I was just trying to maintain my dignity."
"Well then, it seems you almost died twice trying to maintain your worthless dignity. If I had hit you properly, your head would've been gone."
"But there's no longer any reason for this Lanke Hallovich to respect you!"
Lanke's pupils turned blood red.
Suddenly, a thorny whip was formed in his hand.
"A thorny whip? You use such a refined weapon."
Swish!
With a tearing sound, the whip flew in.
Just by lightly swinging his hand and releasing magical energy, Lanke shattered dozens of remnants of chaos.
Of course, the power of a whip properly loaded with energy wouldn't be comparable.
'Come to think of it, this is the first time I've fought with anyone since the last duel with the Baba brothers.'
Perhaps that's why.
Jin felt Lanke's whip as harmless.
It felt just like watching the clumsy swordsmanship of novice warriors.
He simply couldn't feel that Lanke was strong.
'You're not thinking of dodging?'
Thud, snap...!
As Jin grabbed the thorny whip barehanded, Lanke's eyes widened as if they were about to pop out.
The spikes from the solid demon world thorn tree were shattering helplessly in Jin's grip.
'He was far below Bianca only two and a half years ago…! Did everyone lie to me!? He grabbed this with his bare hands right now?'
The information Lanke had about Jin was all from the stories he heard from the members of Kinselo.
So, he knew that Jin's power was already near 10-star 2 years and 6 months ago, and he took into account that he would have made significant progress after entering closed-door training.
But the human who was holding the whip now was very different from the stories the members had told about him.
"The only reason I haven't killed you outright is one, demon."
"Lanke. Lanke Hallovich!"
"It's because I'm curious. Why the Mitra desert has become this way, and why you said this place is a playground. Explain it as detailed as possible. Then I'll grant you a bit of mercy."
"Mercy. Ha, I'm speechless."
"It means I'll kill you with less pain."
"You seem to have grown a bit more than what I've heard, but don't get cocky. This Lanke is very strong."
"Is that so? You seem very laughable compared to Bianca Caligo."
"I'm far superior to be compared with that imbecile from the Caligo family... Don't compare me to such a lowly man!"
Eek!
Lanke pulled the whip with all his might.
But Jin was as immovable as a rock, and Lanke's posture just looked funny. Moreover, Jin was still at ease, using only one hand.
"Ha, haha. Fine, I admit it. You're... stronger than me!"
Lanke pulled out a new thorny whip and started attacking Jin again. Only then did Jin swing his Siegmund and easily repel the whip.
"Do you really not understand the situation, or do you have something else you believe in? Are you waiting for your comrades to come?"
"This Lanke doesn't need that."
Lanke, who was saying that, suddenly felt a chill on his nape.
Because Jin, who should have been beyond the pouring whip, had disappeared somewhere.
"It seems you're not used to fighting someone stronger than you. When this happens, you shouldn't forcefully muster up courage to overcome fear…."
Jin's voice came from the side. It was ten steps away, a distance where it wouldn't be strange if his throat was slit in the blink of an eye.

"Quickly acknowledging defeat and thinking about survival is the best. For that, you have to prove your worth to your opponent. You have to plead for your life by presenting reasons and grounds not to be killed immediately if you want to have a future. Moreover, didn't I tell you personally what I want?"
Kwaaaa-!
The magic power Lanke fired covered Jin like a dragon's breath.
Of course, Jin easily avoided the magic power and regained his position.
The magic power that extended into the void went far away, sweeping away everything in its path.
Thump, thump, thump...! Lanke's heart was pounding in his chest.
Fear, an emotion he hadn't felt for a long time, was severely oppressing him.
"Tell me why the desert has become like this."
There was no threat in Jin's voice.
It was just a calm tone, but Lanke could feel cold sweat popping out from all his pores.
Huff, puff, Lanke's breathing became rough.
He was thinking about his father.
'Does this damned human... really have a power that matches my father's?'
It felt as if his father was standing in front of him.
The terrible sensation that an unbreakable giant wall was suffocating him from all sides was plunging Lanke into a swamp of panic.
"The, the desert..."
"Yes, it seems you're getting a little smarter now."
"The desert... the desert is, I mean."
He waited for a while, but Lanke, trembling, couldn't finish his sentence.
'This guy, something's a little off with him.'
At the moment when Jin was about to approach to threaten him once, Lanke's whip whisked past Jin's eyes.
He reacted smoothly, but it was definitely a sharper attack than before.
It was an attack that Lanke had unconsciously swung.
Now, even Jin's gaze was filled with killing intent.
"I'm not sure whether you're scared of me, or if some unpleasant memory has come up. But if you take a hit, you'll come to your senses."
At the same time. In the old headquarters of Kinzelo, the land of the beastmen.
"What? Lanke went out alone because he thought something was happening in the desert?"
"Eh? Is there any problem there?"
Ainas Caligo and Bubarr Gaston. The two were amicably sharing sweet potato croquettes, as usual, receiving reports from the beastmen.
Among those left in the old headquarters, Lanke was the only one who could detect the battle in the desert.
"If it's Lanke's summoning experiment, it's possible."
"Oh, there was that strange experiment where he said he would summon the spirits of the old demon lords."
"Hmm. What do you think, Bubarr! Should we tell the lords or my sister?"
"If it's another simple experiment accident like last time, wouldn't it be embarrassing for Lanke? He's the type who can't stand such things."
"What if it's not Lanke's experiment but an intruder? The desert is also the area where Jin Runcandel was last believed to have moved."
"Hey, it's been over a year since the desert was polluted. Everyone's been using it as a disposal site for experiments, would that damned guy continue to train there? We've also searched."
"Of course, that's right? Bubarr, no matter how I look at it, you're smart! Well, even if there were intruders, it would just be the Tican guys trying to salvage the waste."
"Even if Lanke is a bit of a fool, he's not the type to be defeated by the likes of the Tican guys."

"Well, he wouldn't even be a match for my sister. But Lanke is strong. Especially when he's out of control, he's really strong. Even before the demon world fell, he was quite recognized when he went berserk. Anyway, when Lanke comes back, let's prepare a meal. Something delicious!"
"Let's also test the new cookies that could break the Litra Teahouse!"
"Cough, ack..."
While Ainas and Bubarr were chatting away, Lanke was suffering a truly brutal defeat at the hands of Jin.
Whenever his trauma about his father was triggered, Lanke usually became stronger by going berserk, and in that state, he never lost to anyone. He didn't remember how he won, though.
But today, the unbeaten streak of 'Berserk Lanke' was broken.
He couldn't remember the process when he won, but this time was different.
He did manage to keep up the fight for a very brief moment, but from the point when he started to be pushed back in earnest, his frenzy subsided and his senses returned.
"Hoo."
Jin wiped his forehead and panted.
He, too, was bleeding from several cuts and tears on his body.
There were no fatal wounds, but there were a few injuries that could be called severe.
However, if he hadn't fought while protecting the bag containing Rafarosa's items, it would have ended with just some minor cuts.
"So, the demon, your words."
"Again... being called... a demon, I am La... Lanke... Halobic. I've heard your wish... you should also... have a little, cough, manners...."
Lanke vomits blood. He was barely breathing with all his limbs broken.

"Yes, Lanke Halobic. You certainly show some resilience. Anyway, according to your explanation, the reason the desert has come to this state is because after the pollution, all the factions used it as a disposal site for experiments. And you just liked this place and used it as a playground?"
"The first makes sense, but the second lacks. You were trying to do something here."
"Just... I liked it here, cough."
Jin took a moment to think about what Lanke was trying to do here.
And Lanke was conscious of the bag that Jin had been protecting all along.
Finally, creating an opportunity to target that bag seemed like the only way he could survive.
And Jin decided that no matter what Lanke was trying to do, it was a problem that could be figured out later.
"Well, that's enough. I'll handle the rest. Oh, and just so you know. If you're thinking of getting out of this predicament by messing with my bag, don't."
Lanke hung his head.
He had been trying to make a move even before things got this messed up, but in the end, he couldn't even scratch the bag.
It would be even more difficult now, and it was absolutely impossible as long as Jin was clearly aware.
"I lost, kill me..."
"That's the plan. Is there anything you want to say?"
"Erect a stone... in this place... honoring my authority and honor..."
While listening to Lanke's last words,
Suddenly, Jin swiftly struck down his sword towards the fallen Lanke.
Because the iron door of Beast King Orgal, which had always appeared unexpectedly when the key person of Kinzelo was in crisis, was formed above Lanke.
'Ha! It's been a while since that damned iron door.'
Swoosh!
The iron door absorbed Lanke a bit faster. Jin glared at the iron door, narrowing his eyes in annoyance.
Even after saving Lanke, the iron door didn't disappear right away and delivered a voice to Jin.
[You're back, Jin Runcandel.]
It was the voice of Orgal, the leader of Kinzelo.
